info.description: A keyed content block on a page — heading, copy and an optional list of cards. Used for sections that exist on only some regions, so each one does not need its own content type.

key.description: Stable identifier the frontend looks the section up by, e.g. home-investment, why-benefits.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the heading (the legacy sectionName).

bullets.description: Optional list of strings rendered under the description.
